name: Silva Villas Phuket
shortDescription: Gated boutique collection of four 3-bedroom pool villas of 290-350 sqm near Laguna and Bang Tao, from THB 22.5 million. Completion Sep 2027.
description:
Silva (listed on FazWaz as Silva Phuket and marketed by phuket.pro as Silva Villas) is a gated boutique collection of four private pool villas in the Cherng Talay and Si Sunthon area behind Laguna Phuket and Bang Tao. Each villa has three bedrooms and four bathrooms, with about 290 to 350 sqm of built-up space (the agent listing gives 290 to 310 sqm) on plots of about 189 to 213 sqm. The renders show a private pool with a waterfall, a double-height open-plan living and dining area, a Western kitchen, a loft bedroom and a landscaped garden terrace, with parking for two cars.
Completion is scheduled for September 2027 and the project is off-plan. FazWaz lists 24-hour security and CCTV, pets allowed, and common-area fees of THB 25 per sqm per month with a sinking fund of THB 500 per sqm. Listed asking prices run from THB 22.5 million to 25 million.
The agent listing gives drive times: Blue Tree about 3 minutes, Boat Avenue 8, Porto de Phuket and Laguna Phuket 10, Bang Tao Beach 10 to 15, HeadStart International School 10 and the airport about 25 minutes. FazWaz measures Bang Tao Beach at about 6 km and the airport at 18.8 km in a straight line. Do not confuse it with Silva Residences, a separate project.

researchNotes: Name ambiguity: user brief says "Silva Villas Phuket"; FazWaz/Hipflat/Papaya call it "Silva" / "Silva Phuket" (Si Sunthon, Thalang). A different project, Silva Residences (Cherngtalay, 4 pool villas, ~290 sqm, THB 22.5-23.5M, DDProperty), is NOT this one. Developer inferred from the Papaya URL path (annara-group); FazWaz does not name one. Private pool confirmed by the phuket.pro listing and renders. Ownership not verified. No official website found. | Images 2026-11-25: 11 renders from phuket.pro project page and the private listing 3188 for Silva Villas (a portal/agency site, not the developer). Listing facts: 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, private pool, open-plan living, Western kitchen, parking for 2 cars, gated boutique development of 4 villas, plot 189-213 sqm, built-up 290-310 sqm, from THB 22.5M; 3 min to Blue Tree, 8 min Boat Avenue, 10 min Porto de Phuket and Laguna, 10-15 min Bang Tao Beach, 10 min HeadStart International School, 25 min airport. Images are 960 px wide (not upscaled).
